title: Chapter 1201
text:
More than half a month passed in the blink of an eye. Because the Battle of Milton was over, the Pro League, which was still in its preparation period, became more and more popular. Most players preferred to pay attention to new events, and analysis posts about the strength of the professional players of the various clubs began to flood the forums. The various teams also began to promote and mobilize.

However, Han Xiao did not pay attention to any of this. As soon as the dynasty's Gold blueprint was in his hands, he threw everything to Sylvia and focused on the machine.

Because it was his first time creating this blueprint, Han Technician spent half a month fiddling with it. After many failures and accumulating a lot of proficiency points, he finally created a Gold grade product and obtained one God's Trait Transformation point.

"It's finally done!"

[God's Trait Transformation — Machinery] has reached Stage 10.

Your life level has undergone an unknown change.

You have a new understanding of machinery. + 15% chance of forming a unique talent. [Universal Simulation] has been upgraded.

You have perceived a portion of the authority of the transformation route — [Unknown Talent].

You have received 1 [The First Sanctum] Ability Fragment.

"Hmm, I guessed right. It's indeed five stages as one level." Han Xiao nodded.

When his God's Trait Transformation reached Stage 5, the same notification appeared, and this time, he had obtained another [The First Sanctum] fragment.

He looked at the effects of Stage 10. From [Apostle Mechanic] to [Divine Throne Mechanic], his Machinery Skill Level + 3, Machinery Affinity + 1.2x, Ability Strength + 40%, Attack Power + 1.3x, Shield Strength + 1.3x, Machinery Core Power + 60%, Output Power + 30% … It was basically a copy of Stage 5, but it was a little better.

"Just like Stage 5, this wave also increases my combat strength. Not bad, not bad … Eh, what's this?"

Han Xiao glanced at it and suddenly exclaimed in surprise. He realized that the progress behind the ability's name had changed. It should have been [10/?]. Now, it had become [10/15].

"The question marks have changed … So the maximum number of God's Trait Transformations is 15? It seems that this limit can only be seen after reaching a certain level."

He browsed through it carefully and found that it wasn't just a small change. From the tenth level to the eleventh level, the transformation point requirement had suddenly increased to six. At the same time, an unexpected notification popped up.

Your [God's Trait Transformation-Machinery] has reached Stage 10.

You have triggered a transformation requirement. Every time you complete a requirement, you can reduce the God's Trait Transformation Point cost by 1.

1. Reach Level 345

2. Comprehend an Exclusive Talent.

Develop a Gold Grade Blueprint on your own.

"Not only do the transformations from the tenth level and above require points, but they also require hard conditions. It's a bit like an advancement mission. I wonder if the Mission Completion Card will work." Han Xiaoxin thought.

Although he was a little surprised by the changes in the God's Trait Transformation, he had no intention of testing it for the time being. He turned around and asked the mechanical assistants to tidy up the workshop before using the King to teleport to a barren planet where he had already buried a beacon.

Swoosh!

His vision changed, and he was already in a desolate underground canyon. Looking up, the cliff extended all the way to the sky, forming a line of sight.

This was a planet located in the center of the Black Star Corps' territory. He had chosen to advance here because he did not want to cause too much of a commotion.

Han Xiao put away the 'Throne' that the mechanical army had placed here, took out the Evolution Cube, and activated it.

Hum!

The pitch-black evolution energy spread out, and Han Xiao guided it into his body. A tide-like pain suddenly erupted, and a black cocoon formed outside his body.

On the interface, notifications of the Evolution Cube taking effect flooded the screen like a waterfall. Han Xiao silently endured the pain brought by the evolution and looked at the notifications.

You have used the Evolution Cube (Gold Quality)!

You have received a permanent special buff — [Gene Optimization — Evolution Cube]!

Detecting species … Detection complete. Your current species is [Black Star Race].

Your gene structure is being optimized …

The first optimization was successful. Your potential has increased … It has been detected that you have triggered this level of optimization. You have received the following attributes: + 0 STR, + 0 DEX, + 1 END, + 2 INT, + 0 MYS, + 0 CHA, + 3 Energy.

Your Energy Level is higher than Lv.0. The second optimization was successful. Your potential has increased … It has been detected that you have triggered this level of optimization. You have received the following attributes: + 1 STR, + 1 DEX, + 2 END, + 3 INT, + 0 MYS, + 0 CHA, + 4 Energy.

…

During this period, he had taken the time to practice the Dragon Emperor Star Energy Absorption Technique. The day before yesterday, he had already reached the standard of level twenty-four of the Energy Realm.

When he used the Evolution Cube for the first time, his Energy Level was only Lv.14. The genetic optimization from level one to level sixteen had been triggered before, and the effect of repeated use was far less than before. However, the genetic optimization from level seventeen to level twenty-six was triggered for the first time, so the effect was normal.

All in all, his STR and DEX had increased by about 700 points, his END had increased by about 900 points, and his INT had increased by about 1,100 points. His MYS and CHA had increased by about 500 points, which added up to about 4,500 attribute points. As for his Energy, it had increased by about 4,000 points.

"The effect is not bad. The increase is even greater than the first time. The main reason is that the higher the level, the greater the increase."

You have received 26 levels of genetic optimization. + 40% EXP required to level up. Duration: 26 months.

You have met the special conditions: You have an exclusive Racial Talent and have received more than 20 levels of genetic optimization.

You have triggered a special effect.

During the next Race Evolution, your attributes will increase by 30%, and your exclusive Racial Talent will be strengthened.

Genetic optimization complete.

With a crack, the black cocoon shattered, and the evolution energy returned to the Evolution Cube.

The pain caused by the genetic optimization slowly subsided. Han Xiao's nerves were now extremely tough, and this little bit of pain could not even distract him. He looked at the notification on the interface and could not help but be overjoyed.

He had thought that the Evolution Cube would only give him a bonus of ten levels the first time he used it, and the bonus effect of twenty levels was something he did not expect. In his previous life, no player had triggered it before, and no one had such a high Energy Level.

"Last time, it provided an additional Race Evolution opportunity. This time, it increases the attributes of the Race Evolution. Wonderful."

Han Xiao's eyes sparkled.

During the level 300 evolution, the evolution option of the Void Angel level had already appeared. This meant that the level 340 evolution would touch the peak of the Void route, and there was an eighty percent chance that the Gene Limiter would be removed!

With the Gene Limiter removed, the attributes of the Race Evolution would be much higher than normal evolution, so he was pleasantly surprised.

"Good things come in pairs! It wasn't in vain that I spent time with Fudin whenever I had free time! "

Han Xiao was extremely excited.

Taking a deep breath, he calmed himself down and put away the Evolution Cube. His expression became serious.

He looked at the 'Completed' status of the level 340 Promotion Mission and solemnly chose to complete it.

Boom!

The ground shook!

Level 340 Promotion Mission completed!

Promotion successful!

+ 120 Basic END Bonus! 1 END = 690 Health = 700 Stamina.

On the path of evolution, you have once again taken a step forward.

Your race has been detected as [Black Star Race] (Exclusive race, unable to be changed).

Randomly drawing 5 matching evolutionary directions … Drawing … Drawing complete!]

Please select two from the five races below to receive a talent each.

1. [Saint Carmel Race]

2. [Void Deity (Human Form)]

3. [Internal Star]

4. [Void Ancestor — New (Human Form)]

5. [Void World Worm]

"What are these two things?"

Han Xiao endured the drastic changes in his body and was confused.

Of the five options, he had never heard of [Saint Carmel Race] and [Internal Star]. He checked the database, but there was no record of them either.

"At this level of evolution, there's finally something new that I haven't seen before."

Han Xiao was a little curious, but since he had already come this far, he naturally had no intention of changing. He did not know what abilities these two options had, so he did not plan to take the risk.

As for the Void World Worm, he knew that it was a symbiotic life form born in the Void Dimension and was an important part of the natural cycle of the dimension. It usually fed on Void Energy and space turbulence, forming solid excrement. It was one of the sources of matter in the Void Dimension.

The Void Spirit and the Void Ancestor were the pinnacle of the evolution path of the Void, and they both had the effect of removing the Gene Limiter. Han Xiao did not hesitate and directly chose these two races, choosing a talent from each of them.

You have received a new talent [Gene Limiter Removal]!

You have received a new talent [Void Authority].

[Gene Limiter Removal]: Your body's strength can break through the limits of your species, greatly releasing your potential. You will receive a huge amount of attributes, and there is a chance to increase related attributes when doing daily activities.

[Void Authority]: You can control the Void Dimension to a certain extent (including but not limited to: using Void Energy to strengthen yourself, absorbing Void Dimension at high speed, transforming Void Energy into Energy, summoning the Void Dimension …)

"Void Authority … Kasuyi definitely has this ability. Otherwise, his Energy Recovery Speed would not be so terrifying …"

Han Xiao nodded. This ability was the most valuable one out of all the talents, and it was equivalent to obtaining a part of the Void Dimension's operation authority.

Your Black Star Race talent [Mechanical Genius] has been improved.

[Mechanical Genius]: Machinery Affinity increased from 1.28x to 1.38x. Machinery Creation Performance increased from 44% to 54%. + 1 All Mechanic Skills. Effect unchanged.

Prompt! [Gene Optimization — Evolution Cube]'s effect has been activated!

Your Black Star Race talent [Mechanical Genius] has been improved.

[Mechanical Genius]: Machinery Affinity increased from 1.38x to 1.48x. Machinery Creation Performance increased from 54% to 64%. + 2 All Mechanic Skills.

Life Level Sublimation, Molecular Structure Improvement, Organ Structure Strengthening, Metabolism Changes …

The Black Star Race's potential has been improved. You have received + 410 STR, + 384 DEX, + 561 END, + 901 INT, + 659 MYS, + 347 CHA, + 10000 Energy. Energy Realm bonus attributes have been changed.

[Gene Limiter Removal] has taken effect. According to your current life level, race potential, and current attributes, you have received bonus attributes: + 1,876 STR, + 1,670 DEX, + 2,348 END, + 3,971 INT, + 1,350 MYS, + 966 CHA, + 23400 Energy.

Prompt! [Gene Optimization — Evolution Cube]'s effect has been activated!

"F * ck, what the f * ck?"

Han Xiao's pupils constricted, and he could not help but speak in his native language.

This attribute replenishment was the biggest one he had received so far. Including the bonus from the Evolution Cube, the total attribute points he had received this time was around 20,000!

At this time, the energy in his body became more and more unstable. Han Xiao's entire body emitted a dazzling light as if he had turned into a Star Core.

The surging energy rampaged within his body, as if it was looking for an exit. He couldn't hold it in any longer.

The next moment, his body shook violently, and the energy shot out.

Boom!

With Han Xiao's body as the center, the violent energy suddenly swept out.

The earth instantly shattered and melted, turning into a blazing red magma ocean.

This desolate planet was like a black egg. The next second, it exploded, and a golden sun broke out of its shell!

At this moment, there was only one thought left in Han Xiaoxin's mind.

Luckily, I didn't advance in my base camp. Otherwise, my home would be gone …
